summary: Legend Biotech filed a Form 6-K disclosing compensation details for Alan Bash, appointed Interim CEO effective July 24, 2026. The Compensation Committee approved bi-weekly cash pay of $12,019 starting July 27, 2026, in addition to his existing President role compensation, plus a one-time RSU grant valued at $50,000 with a grant date of August 14, 2026, vesting one-third annually over three years. This is an abrupt leadership transition, though the filing itself covers compensation terms, not the departure event. The appointment was previously reported on a July 27, 2026 Form 6-K. What to watch: stability of leadership and impact on strategic direction.
